query:
SELECT d.id FROM dokument d 
        INNER JOIN dokumententyp dt ON dt.id = d.typ 
        WHERE 
        d.hash = $1 OR
        d.api_id = $2 OR
        (d.drucksnr = $3 AND dt.value = $4 
            AND ($5 BETWEEN (d.zp_referenz-'12 hours'::interval) 
            AND (d.zp_referenz+'12 hours'::interval)))
